title: The opponent's player info strip (name 'Goldfish', VP x/8, Resources Energy) that was fully visible at step 00 is now occluded by the opponent's CHAOS(3)/FURY(2) rune panel — only the 'G' avatar and a clipped 'G' remain visible at top-right in 34.png/35.png.
expected: gameplay.html:149 places `#opponent-runePool` with inline `style="position:absolute;top:4px;right:8px;"` inside `.opponent-area`, while gameplay.html:143 puts `#opponentInfo` (name/VP/energy strip) as the right-most flex child of the top row of that same area. No space is reserved for the absolutely-positioned pool (.opponent-area CSS at gameplay.css:99 has no padding-right/offset; .rune-stack is 112px wide x 172px tall per gameplay.css:511-515 with opaque cards), so once the opponent has any runes the stacks paint directly over the info strip. Screenshots verify: 00.png (opponent pool empty) shows 'Goldfish VP 0/8 Resources Energy 0' at top-right; 35.png shows CHAOS(3)/FURY(2) stacks covering that spot with only the 'G' avatar and a clipped 'G' visible.
